signal_description: Both images show four similar objects with the third from left singled out: A has the third pole lit green among red lights; B has the third observatory dome open and beaming light.
basis: Two images use the same positional cue, the 3rd of 4. That maps to P3 by ID order and also by list order. P3 qualifies but is not client-correct (P4 has the lowest energy). The two cues agree, but the images alone do not show shared intent or a known convention.
